criteria.source_text: Retain file observation identities through the complete walk and revalidate every encountered leaf, including excluded generated leaves, using complete descriptor metadata and named-entry joins at the final admission boundary. Bind the accepted source/output generation to the spawn under custody that prevents the admitted generation from changing before use. Directory-only revalidation or after-run detection must not substitute for pre-launch alias refusal. Preserve the exact base recipe, output partitions, allowlist, caps and original gates.

criteria.source_text: Provide enforced location custody across each frame-owned mutation and the final admission-to-spawn handoff, rather than observer-only checks before and after it. Use an independently protected writer/location boundary or an equivalent enforced lease that concurrent same-user rename/substitution cannot invalidate while writes or launch are possible. Keep original outside-tree authority limited to the documented window protocol and prescribed preparation records. Do not relabel frame-owned outside-tree writes as the running-target residual or lower the original guarantee; retain this blocker if custody cannot yet be established.

criteria.source_text: Do not lower guarantees, weaken preconditions or postconditions, remove accepted cases, lower proof floors, drop relevant bodies/callers, waive warnings, suppress failures, add assumptions, or replace missing confinement/provenance with a renamed Boolean.

criteria.source_text: Stabilize and independently qualify the remaining source and designs. Import only explicit reviewed deltas into a new isolated integration checkout, resolving shared caller/transaction/ABI/policy changes. Preserve all original fixtures, complete source keysets/modes/directories and inverse lineage. Recompute all effective normalized pins and full ordered proof enrollment without changing the original policy prefix or replacing original accepted cases.
